text:
alex: Hey — PR #17888 is ready for staged rollout. It's a runtime change that introduces an optional eviction header and an infra config tweak. Need approvals: runtime, infra, security. Plan: merge runtime change in canary region (us-west-2) first, then infra toggle, then security hardening. Can we sequence owners?
jun: Saw the diff. Quick q: does this change any on-path protocol? If yes we need compatibility tests. If no, can review today. @alex can you paste the diff summary?
alex: Short summary:
- runtime: add `eviction-prefer` header routing, gated behind feature flag
- infra: add `eviction-service` LB target and healthcheck config
- security: ensure header can't be set by external callers (middleware check)
All tests pass locally: `make test-integration` (CI is green except a flaky test unrelated).
ben: I can do infra + rollout once I see the terraform snippet and canary plan. What's the expected traffic % for canary?
alex: Canary plan:
- 1% traffic to canary for 24h, then 10% for 6h, then 50% for 1h
- Region: us-west-2 initially
Terraform snippet:
```hcl
resource "aws_lb_target_group" "eviction" {
  name = "eviction-service"
  port = 8080
}
```
tara: Small ask: add `area:runtime` and `area:infra` labels on PR and set `rollout-owner` to whoever merges each phase. Also tag the release notes.
maya: Heads up — I'll need a short threat model note and confirmation that header is validated server-side. Also confirm no new secrets. If those are good, I can approve after code walkthrough.
alex: Threat model: header is additive, validated by middleware to only accept signed internal tokens; no new secrets (uses existing KMS key). Code walkthrough: `if (!isInternal(req)) reject(403)`
merge-bot: CI: checks/presubmit — passed. Merge queue: queued for staged-merge.
jun: I'll do a runtime review now. If nothing surprising, I can approve in ~2h.
ben: Infra eyes in ~4h, can schedule infra deploy window tonight 10pm PST.
maya: I can prioritize security review tomorrow morning. If you can add the short threat-model doc in PR description, that speeds it up.
alex: Thanks all. I'll update PR with labels, rollout-owner fields, and threat-model doc now. I'll post back when updated. :thumbsup:
jun: Thanks — ping here when ready.
ben: Thanks — adding to infra schedule.
maya: :eyes:
